name: suspender lunge back crossover
description: A rear lunge where the back leg crosses behind the front one, hitting the glutes and outer hips.
instructions: Hold the handles and stand facing the anchor.
Step one leg back and across behind the other.
Lower until the front thigh is near parallel.
Keep your chest tall and front knee over the ankle.
Push through the front heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
